'''Feenix''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]]. It was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
[[Tanner Cadaman/Legends|Tanner Cadaman]] represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] until his arrest in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
